Home.heroDescription: "The Word of God is alive and active" — Heb 4,12
Home.architectureText: Our parish, with its A-frame design, is a living testament to how architecture can elevate the spirit. The converging roof lines guide the eye upward, inviting every visitor to look beyond the earthly.
Home.donationText: Your contribution helps us maintain our faith community and serve those most in need.
Home.lectioText: Each day the Church offers us her Word. Read today's Gospel and readings, updated every morning with the liturgical calendar.
Home.foundationShortcutText: In Soacha, our parish sustains a mission that provides daily lunch to children, the elderly and expectant mothers, along with tutoring and training. Get to know it and join in.

Foundation.heroText: For more than 7 years, Dei Verbum Parish has carried out its social ministry in favor of the poor and most in need through the Buenos Aires Foundation, in Soacha.
Foundation.sistersNote: Directed by the Sisters of the Child Jesus of Prague
Foundation.serviceMealsText: A nutritious lunch every day for children, the elderly and expectant mothers.
Foundation.serviceSchoolText: Homework guidance and academic support, with a growing library.
Foundation.serviceSewingText: Sewing and dressmaking training for mothers in the community.
Foundation.serviceClosetText: Donated clothing in good condition for those who need it.
Foundation.donationText: Your contribution becomes meals, school supplies and opportunities for more than 140 people in Soacha. Every donation sustains this mission.
Foundation.helpContact: Coordinate your donation with the parish office:
Foundation.externalCta: Read the full story on the Archdiocese website
Foundation.historyText1: Today the Foundation operates from a three-story building in Soacha, where lunch is served daily to 115 boys and girls between 4 and 14 years old, 16 elderly adults, 11 expectant mothers and 2 children with disabilities.
Foundation.historyText2: After a careful restructuring, the parish entrusted the mission to the Sisters of the Child Jesus of Prague — four in total — who oversee the organization, direction, planning and execution of the daily work in favor of the neediest people of the area.
